title: 原材料采购
summary: 评估公司原材料采购的环境和社会风险，包括可持续采购政策与可追溯性。

sections.title_en: Introduction
sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Raw Material Sourcing Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSCI S&C’s),1 outputs are determined. Raw Material Sourcing is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the environmental impacts of the raw materials used in their products and their efforts around supply-chain traceability and certification.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍原材料采购关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解 MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队（MSCI S&C）¹ 如何形成评估结果。原材料采购属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型环境支柱下的关键议题。公司评估涵盖其产品所用原材料的环境影响，以及在供应链可追溯性与认证方面的措施。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of ”ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于MSCI ESG评级模型的更多细节，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"数据、评级和分数"部分。

sections.title_en: Risks associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: • Loss of market access.
blocks.content_cn: • 丧失市场准入资格。

blocks.content: • Increased cost of goods sold or additional compliance costs.
blocks.content_cn: • 销售成本上升或产生额外合规成本。

blocks.content: • Regulatory penalties, fines, confiscation of product, or loss of access to government contracts.
blocks.content_cn: • 监管处罚、罚款、产品被没收，或丧失获取政府合同的资格。

blocks.content: • Damage to brand value.
blocks.content_cn: • 品牌价值受损。

blocks.content: • Failure to meet consumer demand for more environmentally sound products.
blocks.content_cn: • 无法满足消费者对更环保产品的需求。

sections.title_en: Raw Material Sourcing Key Issue score
sections.title_cn: 原材料采购关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Raw Material Sourcing Key Issue score evaluates the company’s level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue score.
blocks.content_cn: 原材料采购关键议题得分评估公司对该议题风险的敞口程度及管理情况。该关键议题得分根据下述公式，基于风险敞口得分和管理得分计算。两项得分的结合方式意味着：风险敞口越高，公司就需要展现越强的管理能力，才能取得相同的总体关键议题得分。

sections.title_en: Raw Material Sourcing Management score
sections.title_cn: 原材料采购管理得分

blocks.content: The Raw Material Sourcing Management score evaluates the company’s ability to manage its exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on weighted average of the score associated with each relevant indicator, modified by controversies.
blocks.content_cn: 原材料采购管理得分评估公司管理该议题风险敞口的能力。它基于各相关指标得分的加权平均值计算，并根据争议事件进行调整。

blocks.content: This score is derived from data points that are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to best practice. Refer to the Analyzing risk management section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. Sources are company disclosures except where otherwise indicated.
blocks.content_cn: 该得分来自采用 0—10 分制的数据点，10 分对应最佳实践。详情参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“风险管理分析”章节。除另有说明外，数据均来自公司披露。

sections.title_en: Raw Material Sourcing Beef & Dairy Policy score
sections.title_cn: 原材料采购牛肉与乳制品政策得分

blocks.content: The Raw Material Sourcing Beef & Dairy Policy score evaluates the company’s initiatives to manage the environmental and social impacts of beef and dairy sourcing through policies, certification, traceability and supplier programs. Highest initiatives reflect clear commitments, measurable targets, stringent certification, and full traceability across the supply chain. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.Commitments towards responsible beef and/or dairy sourcing.
blocks.content_cn: 原材料采购牛肉与乳制品政策得分评估公司通过政策、认证、可追溯性和供应商计划，管理牛肉与乳制品采购环境及社会影响的举措。最高水平的举措体现为明确承诺、可衡量目标、严格认证以及整个供应链的完全可追溯。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。负责任采购牛肉和／或乳制品的承诺。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has an explicit policy to sustainably source beef and/or dairy (e.g., zero-deforestation beef policy) or whether it belongs to an industry group with such a policy (e.g., the Global Roundtable on Responsible Beef).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否具有可持续采购牛肉和／或乳制品的明确政策（例如零毁林牛肉政策），或是否加入了具有此类政策的行业组织（例如全球负责任牛肉圆桌组织）。

blocks.content: • Percentage of beef and/or dairy third-party certified to an environmental sustainability standard.
blocks.content_cn: • 经第三方环境可持续性标准认证的牛肉和／或乳制品比例。

blocks.content: Definition: The estimated share of beef and/or dairy externally certified to sustainable standards (e.g., organic certification).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：估算牛肉和／或乳制品获得外部可持续性标准认证（例如有机认证）的比例。

sections.title_en: • Extent of beef and/or dairy certification against the most stringent sustainable criteria.
sections.title_cn: • 牛肉和／或乳制品按最严格可持续性准则认证的程度。

blocks.content: Definition: The estimated share of the company’s supply of beef and/or dairy externally certified to the most stringent sustainable standards (e.g., Rainforest Alliance).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：估算公司供应的牛肉和／或乳制品获得外部最严格可持续性标准认证（例如雨林联盟认证）的比例。

sections.title_en: • Extent of beef and/or dairy traceability to place of origin.
sections.title_cn: • 牛肉和／或乳制品追溯至原产地的程度

blocks.content: Definition: The estimated level of traceability of beef and/or dairy up to the plantation/farm level. Best practice is for all products to be traceable.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：估算牛肉和／或乳制品追溯至种植园或农场层面的程度。最佳实践是所有产品均可追溯。

sections.title_en: • Extent of supply chain initiatives to address impacts of beef and/or dairy production.
sections.title_cn: • 应对牛肉和／或乳制品生产影响的供应链举措覆盖程度。

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the company’s initiatives to develop sustainable practices within its beef and/or dairy supply chain, e.g., sustainable land management program, methane reduction program, implementation of specific sustainable requirements for suppliers and verification of compliance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司在牛肉和／或乳制品供应链中发展可持续实践的举措程度，例如可持续土地管理计划、甲烷减排计划、对供应商实施具体可持续性要求并核验其遵守情况。

sections.title_en: • Future targets for beef and/or dairy sourcing.
sections.title_cn: • 牛肉和／或乳制品采购的未来目标

blocks.content: Definition: The extent to which the company has clear, measurable targets for certifying or tracing its sources of beef and/or dairy.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司是否就牛肉和／或乳制品来源的认证或追溯设定明确、可衡量目标及其程度。

sections.title_en: Raw Material Sourcing Cotton Policy score
sections.title_cn: 原材料采购棉花政策得分

blocks.content: The Raw Material Sourcing Cotton Policy score evaluates the company’s initiatives to manage the environmental and social impacts of Cotton sourcing through policies, certification, traceability and supplier programs. Highest initiatives reflect clear commitments, measurable targets, stringent certification, and full traceability across the supply chain. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.Commitments towards responsible cotton sourcing.
blocks.content_cn: 原材料采购棉花政策得分评估公司通过政策、认证、可追溯性和供应商计划，管理棉花采购环境及社会影响的举措。最高水平的举措体现为明确承诺、可衡量目标、严格认证以及整个供应链的完全可追溯。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。负责任采购棉花的承诺。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has an explicit policy to sustainably source cotton or whether it belongs to an industry group with such a policy (e.g., Textile Exchange or Better Cotton Initiative).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否具有可持续采购棉花的明确政策，或是否加入了具有此类政策的行业组织（例如纺织品交易所或良好棉花发展协会）。

sections.title_en: • Percentage of cotton third-party certified to an environmental standard.
sections.title_cn: • 经第三方环境标准认证的棉花比例。

blocks.content: Definition: The estimated share of cotton externally certified to sustainable standards (e.g., Better Cotton Initiative).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：估算棉花获得外部可持续性标准认证（例如良好棉花发展协会认证）的比例。

sections.title_en: • Extent of cotton traceability to place of origin.
sections.title_cn: • 棉花追溯至原产地的程度

blocks.content: Definition: The estimated level of traceability of cotton up to the plantation/farm level. Best practice is for all products to be traceable.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：估算棉花追溯至种植园或农场层面的程度。最佳实践是所有产品均可追溯。

sections.title_en: • Extent of supply chain initiatives to address impacts of cotton production.
sections.title_cn: • 应对棉花生产影响的供应链举措覆盖程度。

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the company’s initiatives to develop sustainable practices within its cotton supply chain, e.g., water and pesticide reduction programs, technical assistance to obtain sustainable certification.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司在棉花供应链中发展可持续实践的举措程度，例如减少用水和农药使用的计划，以及为取得可持续性认证提供技术援助。

sections.title_en: • Future targets for cotton sourcing.
sections.title_cn: • 棉花采购的未来目标

blocks.content: Definition: The extent to which the company has clear, measurable targets for certifying or tracing its sources of cotton.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司是否就棉花来源的认证或追溯设定明确、可衡量目标及其程度。

sections.title_en: Raw Material Sourcing Leather Policy score
sections.title_cn: 原材料采购皮革政策得分

blocks.content: The Raw Material Sourcing Leather Policy score evaluates the company’s initiatives to manage the environmental and social impacts of leather sourcing through policies, certification, traceability, and supplier programs. Highest initiatives reflect clear commitments, measurable targets, stringent certification and full traceability across the supply chain. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 原材料采购皮革政策得分评估公司通过政策、认证、可追溯性和供应商计划，管理皮革采购环境及社会影响的举措。最高水平的举措体现为明确承诺、可衡量目标、严格认证以及整个供应链的完全可追溯。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: • Commitments towards responsible leather sourcing.
sections.title_cn: • 负责任采购皮革的承诺

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has an explicit policy to sustainably source leather (e.g., addressing deforestation) or whether it belongs to an industry group with such a policy (e.g., Leather Working Group).

sections.title_en: • Percentage of leather third-party certified to an environmental sustainability standard.
sections.title_cn: • 经第三方环境可持续性标准认证的皮革比例。

sections.title_en: • Extent of leather certification against the most stringent sustainable criteria.
sections.title_cn: • 皮革按最严格可持续性准则认证的程度。

blocks.content: Definition: The estimated share of the company’s supply of leather externally certified to the most stringent sustainable standards (e.g., Recycled).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：估算公司供应的皮革获得外部最严格可持续性标准认证（例如再生材料认证）的比例。

sections.title_en: • Extent of leather traceability to place of origin.

blocks.content: Definition: The estimated level of traceability of leather up to the plantation/farm level. Best practice is for all products to be traceable.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：估算皮革追溯至种植园或农场层面的程度。最佳实践是所有产品均可追溯。

blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司在皮革供应链中发展可持续实践的举措程度，例如为取得可持续性认证提供技术援助，以及减少染色和鞣制过程中的化学品使用。

sections.title_en: • Future targets for leather sourcing.

sections.title_en: • Commitments towards responsible palm oil sourcing.
sections.title_cn: • 负责任采购棕榈油的承诺

blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否具有可持续采购棕榈油的明确政策（例如不毁林、不开发泥炭地、不剥削政策），或是否加入了具有此类政策的行业组织（例如可持续棕榈油圆桌倡议）。

sections.title_en: • Extent of palm oil traceability to place of origin.

sections.title_en: • Extent of supply chain initiatives to address impacts of palm oil production.
sections.title_cn: • 应对棕榈油生产影响的供应链举措覆盖程度。

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the company’s initiatives to develop sustainable practices within its palm oil supply chain, e.g., technical assistance to obtain sustainable certification, implementation of specific sustainable requirements for suppliers and verification of compliance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司在棕榈油供应链中发展可持续实践的举措程度，例如为取得可持续性认证提供技术援助、对供应商实施具体可持续性要求并核验其遵守情况。

sections.title_cn: • 经第三方环境可持续性标准认证的海产品比例。

blocks.content_cn: 定义：估算公司供应的海产品获得外部最严格可持续性标准认证（例如海洋管理委员会或水产养殖管理委员会认证）的比例。

sections.title_en: • Extent of seafood traceability to place of origin.
sections.title_cn: • 海产品追溯至原产地的程度

sections.title_en: • Future targets for seafood sourcing.

blocks.content: A controversy deduction ranging from 0 to 5 points is subtracted from the overall Management score based on the severity, status, and the company’s role in the controversies facing the company on this Key Issue. The following categories of controversies are used in the assessment:
blocks.content_cn: 根据公司在该关键议题所面临争议事件的严重程度、状态以及公司所扮演的角色，从总体管理得分中扣除0至5分。评估使用以下类别的争议事件。
